items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: So he came to New York with Adelaide Hall

ctx.x: So he came to New York with Adelaide Hall, and I think we spoke of the rhythm club before, and he come to the rhythm club -- somebody brought him by -- and I

was there -- I happened to be there in town at the same time. And he sat down to the piano in the rhythm club and played. And Fats was there and Fats Waller went and got every piano player that he could find. He went and got the Lion.
